statutory_framework.section_13: Section 13 (Hours of work: Max 8 hours/day and 48 hours/week, extendable to 10 hours for long distance)
statutory_framework.section_15: Section 15 (Daily intervals for rest: Max 5 hours continuous work without min 30 minutes rest)
statutory_framework.section_16: Section 16 (Spreadover: Max 12 hours/day including rest intervals)
statutory_framework.penalty_section: Section 31 (Penalties for contravention of provisions regarding employment)
